title: 1dSEM
description: Computes path coefficients for connection matrix in Structural Equation Modeling (SEM).

theta.description: Connection matrix 1D file with initial representation
theta.title: Theta File

max_iterations.description: Maximum number of iterations for convergence (Default=10000). Values can range from 1 to any positive integer less than 10000.
max_iterations.title: Maximum Iterations

number_random_trials.description: Number of random trials before optimization (Default = 100).
number_random_trials.title: Random Trials

limits.description: Lower and upper limits for connection coefficients (Default = -1.0 to 1.0)
limits.title: Limits

calculate_cost.description: No modeling at all, just calculate the cost function for the coefficients as given in the theta file.
calculate_cost.title: Calculate Cost Flag

tree_growth.description: Search for best model by growing a model for one additional coefficient from the previous model for n-1 coefficients.
tree_growth.title: Tree Growth Flag

model_search.description: Search for best model by growing a model for one additional coefficient from the previous model for n-1 coefficients.
model_search.title: Model Search Flag

max_paths.description: Maximum number of paths to include (Default = 1000).
max_paths.title: Maximum Paths

stop_cost.description: Stop searching for paths when cost function is below this value (Default = 0.1).
stop_cost.title: Stop Cost

forest_growth.description: Search over all possible models by comparing models at incrementally increasing number of path coefficients.
forest_growth.title: Forest Growth Flag

grow_all.description: Search over all possible models by comparing models at incrementally increasing number of path coefficients.
grow_all.title: Grow All Flag

leafpicker.description: Expands the search optimization to look at multiple paths to avoid local minimum. This method is the default technique for tree growth and standard coefficient searches.
leafpicker.title: Leafpicker Flag
